name: A Taste of the Sea
summary: Fimbo Greasemitz wants fresh seafood for a new stew at his cafe on the water. You gather local ingredients to change up the menu.

sections.title: A New Dish
sections.body: Fimbo Greasemitz runs a cafe on the water, where roasted boar and fish fill the menu each day. He wants to try a seafood stew and asks you to bring him murloc eyes and Sand Crawler meat from nearby beaches.

faq.answer: Fimbo Greasemitz runs a cafe on the water and wants to add seafood stew to its menu.
Fimbo asks for murloc eyes and Sand Crawler meat for his seafood stew.
He wants a new seafood stew recipe to shake up the cafe's daily menu of roasted boar and fish.

faq.q: Where can you find the ingredients?
faq.answer: Fimbo says the murloc eyes and Sand Crawler meat can be found along the nearby beaches.

angles.text: As a cook, you can see Fimbo seeking fresh local ingredients for a seafood stew.
